messages:
Noah: Morning — left muffins in the kitchen labeled `v0.0.0-demo` so people would be suspicious. :smile:
Chi: Please don't alpha test pastries on my desk. Last time the croissants turned into a flaky release train.
Tara: The coffee machine is now running a YAML config apparently. Log excerpt:
```yaml
coffee:
  strength: strong
  milk: true
  syrup: "hazelnut"
```
Chi: Missing quote -> coffee daemon segfaults with 'unexpected syrup token'. Sounds familiar. :sweat_smile:
Noah: I propose we add a lint step to kitchen-ci: `kitchen-lint --check-yaml` before breakfast deploys.
build-bot: kitchen-ci: lint failed on branch `muffins/experiment` - found unquoted strings and un-semvered toppings. Ticket #KITCH-87 created. :robot_face:
Tara: Poll: semver condiments? React :maple_leaf: for yes, :shrug: for no. I'll tally at 2pm.
Chi: Also funny sticker on the whiteboard: "Compilation successful: it runs in production until someone eats it."
Noah: Whoever writes the brunch release notes, please include a migration example: "How to roll back to butter-legacy when the toaster goes to v2.0.0".
Tara: :thumbsup: I'll add docs(brunch): semver-and-yaml-manners to the backlog.
